While science fiction lore tells us that humans will meet extraterrestrial life in the form of little green men, the detail that should raise hairs this Halloween is this: the search for extraterrestrial intelligence took a major leap forward with AI, and it increasingly focuses on AI agents built by humans listening for AI agents built by aliens.

Some scientists have suggested that extraterrestrial civilizations, if they exist, could be billions of years older than humanity. Such civilizations might have developed technologies far beyond humanity’s, including forms of AI.

Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute are bringing agentic AI into the daily search for extraterrestrial intelligence. At the Allen Telescope Array in Northern California, agents can now steer the instrument, enhance and correct incoming data, and apply AI models to the incoming stream — all from a single natural language request. The NVIDIA Holoscan platform processes the massive streams of sensor data, giving agents live data to act on.

The result is a faster, more adaptable search for potential signals from extraterrestrial life and technologies.

“As our new agentic observatories reach out into the universe, what they find may have much more in common with themselves than with the humans who created them,” said Andrew Siemion, Bernard M. Oliver chair for SETI at the SETI Institute and principal investigator of Breakthrough Listen. “But this isn’t something to fear. Rather, it’s a breakthrough in translation.”

Terabits a Second, Processed in Flight

Radio telescopes generate enormous volumes of data, creating a challenge for scientists who need to identify potentially interesting signals as observations unfold.

At the Allen Telescope Array, DAQIRI, a Holoscan platform library, enables the telescope to pull terabits per second of sensor data straight into GPU memory so observations are processed in flight rather than filling hard drives. CyberEther, a signal-processing framework developed at the SETI Institute, does the math using NVIDIA CUDA-X libraries including cuFFT and cuBLAS.

Nexus, a web-based observatory orchestrator, acts as the agent harness. It gives agents a single source of truth for instrument state, compute resources and pipelines and lets researchers monitor packet loss, read live spectrograms and rewrite signal-processing blocks — all by prompting in natural language. The system can handle 2.4 terabits per second on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, with inference running on premises, next to the instrument.

Put together, the system enables an agent to steer a telescope’s antennae, calibrate and focus the instrument for a clean signal, catch and fix data errors and plot the result. Agents compress what would take humans weeks or years into hours.

Science Fact, Not Fiction

The pipeline has already proven itself, achieving the first real-time AI detection of a pulsar — a rapidly spinning stellar remnant that pulses like a cosmic lighthouse — in the Crab Nebula. 

Next, the team is evaluating open models including NVIDIA Nemotron for cases where data locality and turnaround matter most and for observatories that may someday run offline on the far side of the moon.

Learn more about NVIDIA AI for science.

translation.html:
科幻故事告诉我们，人类将会遇见以小绿人形象出现的外星生命，但这个万圣节，真正令人毛骨悚然的细节是：借助 AI，搜寻地外智慧生命的工作取得了重大进展，而且越来越聚焦于让人类构建的 AI 智能体监听外星人构建的 AI 智能体。

一些科学家提出，地外文明如果存在，可能比人类文明早数十亿年。这样的文明可能已经发展出远超人类的技术，包括各种形式的 AI。

Breakthrough Listen 和 SETI 研究所正在将智能体 AI 引入日常的地外智慧生命搜寻工作。在位于北加利福尼亚的 艾伦望远镜阵列，如今只需一条自然语言请求，智能体就能操控仪器、增强并校正传入的数据，以及将 AI 模型应用于传入的数据流。NVIDIA Holoscan 平台处理海量传感器数据流，为智能体提供可据以采取行动的实时数据。

由此，对地外生命及技术潜在信号的搜寻变得更快，也更具适应性。

“随着我们新一代智能体天文台向宇宙展开探索，它们发现的事物，与它们自身的共同点可能远多于与创造它们的人类的共同点，”SETI 研究所地外智慧生命搜寻领域 Bernard M. Oliver 教席持有人、Breakthrough Listen 首席研究员 Andrew Siemion 表示。“但这并不值得恐惧。相反，这是翻译上的一次突破。”

每秒数太比特，数据流入即处理

射电望远镜会产生海量数据，这给需要在观测过程中识别潜在有价值信号的科学家带来了挑战。

在艾伦望远镜阵列，Holoscan 平台库 DAQIRI 使望远镜能够将每秒数太比特的传感器数据直接传入 GPU 显存，让观测数据在流入过程中得到处理，而不是堆满硬盘。CyberEther 是 SETI 研究所开发的信号处理框架，使用包括 cuFFT 和 cuBLAS 在内的 NVIDIA CUDA-X 库执行计算。

Nexus 是一个基于网页的天文台编排系统，充当智能体的运行框架。它为智能体提供仪器状态、计算资源和处理流水线的单一权威信息源，并让研究人员仅通过自然语言提示，就能监测丢包、读取实时频谱图以及重写信号处理模块。该系统使用 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU，可处理每秒 2.4 太比特的数据，推理则在仪器旁的本地设施中运行。

这些组件结合起来，使智能体能够调整望远镜天线的指向、校准仪器并调焦以获得清晰信号、发现并修复数据错误，以及绘制结果图。智能体将人类需要数周甚至数年完成的工作压缩到数小时内。

科学事实，而非科幻

这条处理流水线已经证明了自身的能力，首次实现了利用 AI 实时探测到蟹状星云中的一颗脉冲星。脉冲星是一种快速旋转的恒星残骸，像宇宙灯塔一样发出脉冲。 

接下来，团队正在评估包括 NVIDIA Nemotron 在内的开放模型，以用于对数据本地性和处理时效最为重视的场景，以及未来某一天可能在月球背面离线运行的天文台。

进一步了解 NVIDIA 科学 AI。
